Enter plan mode

$ orcacode --plan

› /mode plan
› /mode normal

Use bare /mode to choose between normal, plan, auto, and yolo modes. Normal is the startup default. If multiple explicit startup modes are present, the safer mode wins: plan, then normal, then auto, then yolo.

What can run

Plan mode allows file and directory reading, search, file metadata, paged tool-result reading, web fetch/search/crawl, skill loading, task lists, and clarification questions. It denies shell, processes, Python, Bun, general writes and edits, subagents, and every MCP tool.

WHY AN ALLOWLIST

New skills and MCP servers can add tools the host has never seen. In plan mode, unknown tools are denied rather than assumed harmless.

One writable destination

Markdown plans directly inside docs/plan/ are the only writes plan mode permits. The recommended name is docs/plan/YYYY-MM-DD-feature-name.md.

$ docs/plan/2026-08-26-session-export.md

The agent decides whether the work warrants a file and what to call it. A short question may receive only an answer. A multi-step change should leave a durable plan you can review before switching back to normal mode.
